related.title: Bruce CANDU 重水發電架構
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「蒸汽流量與汽輪機規模」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；Bruce CANDU 重水發電架構的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Steam flow and turbine size" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Bruce CANDU heavy-water generation architecture must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦出口到中國的 CANDU 6：380 根燃料通道、重水存量、開頂式施工與鈷 60 生產；Bruce CANDU 重水發電架構則以全球最大運轉中核電廠之一：壓力管、不停機換料、真空廠房與主要組件更換為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the CANDU 6 exported to China: 380 fuel channels, heavy-water inventory, open-top construction and cobalt-60 production; Bruce CANDU heavy-water generation architecture centres on one of the world's largest operating nuclear sites: pressure tubes, on-power refuelling, the vacuum building and major component replacement, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「重水的來源與存量管理」的模型移到Bruce CANDU 重水發電架構，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「主要組件更換工程」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Sources and inventory management of heavy water" to Bruce CANDU heavy-water generation architecture, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Major component replacement", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「蒸汽流量與汽輪機規模」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；Bruce CANDU 重水發電架構的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Steam flow and turbine size" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Bruce CANDU heavy-water generation architecture must be respecified.

related.title: 達靈頓 CANDU 機組翻新工程
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「蒸汽流量與汽輪機規模」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；達靈頓 CANDU 機組翻新工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Steam flow and turbine size" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Darlington CANDU Refurbishment must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦出口到中國的 CANDU 6：380 根燃料通道、重水存量、開頂式施工與鈷 60 生產；達靈頓 CANDU 機組翻新工程則以四部 CANDU 機組的十年翻新：全尺寸模型、支管減薄、學習曲線與實獲值管理為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the CANDU 6 exported to China: 380 fuel channels, heavy-water inventory, open-top construction and cobalt-60 production; Darlington CANDU Refurbishment centres on A ten-year refurbishment of four CANDU units: a full-scale mock-up, feeder thinning, the learning curve and earned-value management, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「重水的來源與存量管理」的模型移到達靈頓 CANDU 機組翻新工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「集體劑量與作業規劃」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Sources and inventory management of heavy water" to Darlington CANDU Refurbishment, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Collective dose and work planning", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「蒸汽流量與汽輪機規模」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；達靈頓 CANDU 機組翻新工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Steam flow and turbine size" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Darlington CANDU Refurbishment must be respecified.

history.title: 秦山三期 CANDU 6 重水機組
history.text: 1996 年中加簽訂供應合約；1998 年1 號機開工；2002 年1 號機商轉；2003 年2 號機商轉。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1996: China and Canada signed the supply contract. 1998: Construction of unit 1 began. 2002: Unit 1 entered commercial operation. 2003: Unit 2 entered commercial operation. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
